comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. The rhythm style names and the Pattern 1 to Pattern 8 labels are read verbatim from Tantz::Tantz. Each instrument has a pattern switch and a mute switch; the mutes pass the instrument when engaged and start engaged. The step patterns themselves were not traced, so the lines do not describe what any individual pattern plays. The panel prints PERCUSISON on one of the maker's output names, spelled correctly on the panel as PERC 2. RUN is a momentary lit button configured with configSwitch and the choice names Start and Stop, so the tooltip names two positions a momentary button does not have; each press toggles the run state, which starts true. The clock input reads a rising edge through 1V; the six drum CV jacks and the style jack are ±5V, and the swing and gate width jacks 0 to 5V.
